name: SAP Concur
description: SAP Concur is SAP's travel, expense, and invoice management suite, sold as Concur Travel, Concur Expense, and Concur Invoice plus add-ons like ExpenseIt (mobile receipt capture) and Concur Detect (AI-assisted audit). It automates expense reporting, in-policy travel booking, and AP invoice matching/approval, and publishes starting per-report prices for its Base and Plus expense plans while its fullest (Premium) tier and larger contracts are custom-quoted.
best_for: Companies that want to automate travel booking, expense reporting, and invoice/AP processing with policy enforcement and audit controls, independent of which core accounting or ERP system they use.
features: Concur Expense: centralized expense tracking and reporting across an organization
ExpenseIt: mobile receipt capture that automatically matches receipts to card transactions
Concur Detect: AI/machine-learning analysis of expense reports to speed audits and flag policy violations
Concur Travel: in-policy trip booking integrated with Concur Expense for cost control
Concur TripLink: visibility into trips booked outside the managed travel system
Concur Invoice: automated AP with three-way match and pre-transaction purchase-request controls
Intelligence/Analytics: near-real-time, customized spend dashboards and reporting
Mobile app (iOS 12+ and Android 7.0+) for expenses, travel booking, and approvals
pros: Base and Plus tiers show real starting prices ($7 and $11 per expense report) rather than a fully opaque quote wall
Mobile app covers expense capture, travel booking, and approvals from a phone, per SAP Concur's own device-support documentation
AI-assisted tools (ExpenseIt matching, Concur Detect audit flags) aim to cut manual expense-report review work
cons: Actual price varies with contract volume/commitment, and the fullest tier (Premium, adding Concur Travel and Intelligence) is custom-quoted rather than published
Expense, Travel, and Invoice are separate products, so a full travel + expense + AP deployment is priced and assembled from multiple parts rather than one flat plan

pricing.starting_price: $7 per expense report (Base plan, unlimited users)

tiers.name: Base
tiers.notes: Starting price; unlimited users; Concur Expense, positioned for smaller businesses. SAP Concur notes "price can vary based on monthly commitment."

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Starting price; unlimited users; adds ExpenseIt, a user support desk, and reporting.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Custom pricing; unlimited users; adds Concur Travel, Intelligence, and additional advanced capabilities. Requires requesting a quote.

alternatives.name: NetSuite
alternatives.description: Oracle's cloud ERP system with a native Expense Management module covering expense report submission, approval workflows, and mobile receipt capture.
alternatives.best_for: Companies that would rather use expense management built into their core ERP than run a standalone travel & expense product like Concur.
strengths: Expense management built into the core ERP
Ties expenses directly to project accounting and invoicing
One vendor for financials plus expenses

alternatives.name: Odoo
alternatives.description: An open-source, modular business platform with a built-in Expenses app alongside its Accounting, Invoicing, and other finance apps.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller companies that want basic mobile expense capture bundled into a broader, published-pricing business platform rather than a dedicated enterprise T&E product.
strengths: Expenses app bundled at the same per-user price as the rest of Odoo

alternatives.name: Expensify
alternatives.description: An expense management platform with receipt scanning, a commercial card, and in-app travel booking.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting simple receipt-driven expense reports combined with in-app flight, hotel, car, and rail booking, with published self-serve pricing instead of a per-report quote.
strengths: In-app travel booking with automatic expense sync

alternatives.name: Ramp
alternatives.description: A spend management platform combining a fee-free corporate card with AI-driven expense, AP, and procurement automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a free corporate card paired with automated expense and accounts-payable workflows, rather than a per-expense-report pricing model.
strengths: Free plan with no annual fees or interest charges on the card
Policy enforcement and price-drop rebooking for travel
Native bidirectional sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct
